description: Golden vector for the canonical tree packer (specs/asset-registry.md §Tree paths). The orchestrator (TypeScript) and pipeline (Python) packers must produce this archive byte-for-byte for these entries; each suite re-packs the files below and asserts the sha256 as a literal in its own test, so either packer drifting breaks its own CI. The tree deliberately includes a nested directory, an empty file, and names whose bytewise order ('a!' < 'a/' < 'a0') differs from a per-directory filesystem listing.
